messages.body: worker_status: succeeded; advisory reflect verdict FAIL. I ran /sc:workflow (standard, --handoff none, --unattended) and it wrote the 8-task, 4-phase plan .dev/tasks/to-do/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181543/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181543.md covering SPEC sections 3 and 4, the owner decisions and your two rulings (no Unattended section; the six T05-T10 brief copies with the substitution on T05/T07/T09 only); every task has acceptance criteria, Task 8 delivers INSTALL.md, and .dev/tasks is staged. The advisory reflect check (report .dev/brainstorms/346-minfix/workflow-report/nested/reflect-2/REPORT.md, status partial) found 4 blocking plan defects that I did not edit in because reflect is advisory: Task 5 must be allowed to add spec-panel-minfix to _POST_REFRESH_ADDITIONS in tests/recommend/test_routing_refresh.py (plan line 119 forbids it, so CI breaks); the shipped Fix Budget text lacks two SPEC 2.1 step-3 rules (reviewer exit-2 retry and the review-3 listing of budget escalations and GRADE-CONFLICT ids), which need owner sign-off because they change the block the SPEC calls literal and the file is already at the 500-line limit; and Task 4's grep can match __pycache__ files; plus 11 minor items. Not covered: SPEC section 5 measurement and the section 7 replay harness are out of scope, progress.md is not created because /sc:implement writes it, and three brief sources live under /tmp/impl/exp/s1/ and may vanish before Task 8 runs.
